python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/admin_notifications.rb"
s=open(p).read()
for kind in ["proposal","help","map","budget"]:
    old=f'''    random_locales_attributes(
      %i[title body].map do |attribute|
        [attribute, -> {{ I18n.t("seeds.admin_notifications.{kind}.#{{attribute}}") }}]
      end.to_h
    ).merge'''
    new=f'''    random_locales_attributes(
      **%i[title body].map do |attribute|
        [attribute, -> {{ I18n.t("seeds.admin_notifications.{kind}.#{{attribute}}") }}]
      end.to_h
    ).merge'''
    assert old in s, kind
    s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("done")
